source_entailment.evidence: CL1-CL5 are scoped to retrieved primary definitions and instruction conventions (S1-S10); CL6/CL9/CL10 describe shipped code; CL7/CL11 remain proposals and CL8 is an inference. No quality improvement is represented as measured.

first_person_integrity.evidence: The paper uses I propose, I choose and I would validate. Its cover identifies the voice as a worked example; it attributes no invented personal experience or deployments to the user.

standalone_reader.evidence: The context section defines the author, readers, host and source-correction scenario. JSON, Markdown, CLI and C4 container semantics are explained; a glossary and full references are included.

alternatives_fair.evidence: Decisions D1-D3 compare O1-O4, preserve O2 as a strong baseline and state conditions favoring a managed service. Criteria and reversal triggers are explicit.

disconfirmation_substantive.evidence: The decisions record separates executed source/permissions inspection and 17 local tests from planned effectiveness and real-host evaluations. The central benefit is conditional on a pilot.

architecture_feasible.evidence: The four code classes exist in gates.py. The paper scopes the prototype to one local writer and explains contracts, failure recovery, bounded work, storage growth and the absence of independent enforcement.

paper_slide_consistency.evidence: All slides map to declared story beats, sections and claims. The conditional pilot recommendation, untested host boundary and self-review limitations agree across paper, slides and notes.

diagrams_readable.evidence: All four rendered views were inspected; the C3 boundary was corrected to exclude the supporting Store container, and long node text was wrapped. Native shape/text bounds and PDF bounds were checked.

evidence.evidence: Primary definitions and code references support the limited factual claims; effectiveness remains unmeasured.

reasoning.evidence: Four credible options, decision-specific objections and observable reversal conditions; effectiveness experiment remains planned.

architecture.evidence: Runnable local implementation, linked C4 scopes and documented contracts/failure recovery; explicit single-writer and assurance limits.

clarity.evidence: First-person standalone context, defined terms and one recurring source-correction example.

cohesion.evidence: Shared registry and story map validated; paper and all 15 slides preserve the conditional recommendation.

findings.evidence: An initial slide claim was not traceable in its mapped section.
findings.remediation: Corrected the section mapping and explicit claim coverage; the draft gate passes.

findings.evidence: An early bounding rectangle could imply that the supporting Store container was inside Runner.
findings.remediation: Repositioned the three components and the supporting Store; regenerated and inspected views.

findings.evidence: Long descriptions risked exceeding node width.
findings.remediation: Used conservative wrapping, inspected the outputs, and checked text bounds.
